llvm_lowering: LocalRef::Operand / PendingOperand (SSA Value/Pair/ZeroSized) if !is_non_ssa_local; otherwise LocalRef::Place (entry-block alloca with ABI alignment)

Immediate(V) for Scalar/SimdVector (bool is i1 in SSA, zext to i8 in memory); Pair(V, V) for ScalarPair (wide ptrs, 2-field structs/enums); Ref(PlaceValue) for Memory layouts; ZeroSized for 0-byte types

If dest is PendingOperand/Operand: codegen_rvalue_operand + overwrite_local; if dest is LocalRef::Place or projected Place: codegen_rvalue storing into PlaceRef (+ optional codegen_retag_place/operand under -Zcodegen-emit-retag)
Writes direct tag integer or niche-encoded value to tag field GEP for Variants::Multiple { TagEncoding::Direct | Niche }
Calls llvm.lifetime.start.p0(size, ptr) and llvm.lifetime.end.p0(size, ptr) on LocalRef::Place allocas when emit_lifetime_markers is enabled
Evaluates boolean operand as i1 immediate and emits call void @llvm.assume(i1 %cond)
Computes bytes = unchecked_sumul(count, sizeof(T)) and emits call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr align A %dst, ptr align A %src, i64 %bytes, i1 false)
Skips store if entirely uninit const; otherwise loads/evaluates OperandRef and stores to dest (setting MemFlags::CAPTURES_READ_ONLY for &Freeze with WithRetag::Yes)
No-op for ZST; llvm.memset(undef) for uninit const; llvm.memset(byte) for i8/u8; otherwise generates a header/body/next basic-block loop storing elem to each index
codegen_place(place).val.address() -> Immediate(llptr) for thin pointers or Pair(llptr, llextra) for wide pointers

mir_construct: Rvalue::BinaryOp (wrapping, checked, unchecked, wide ptr, float)
llvm_lowering: Checked ops call @llvm.{s,u}{add,sub,mul}.with.overflow.iN returning {iN, i1} Pair; Unchecked ops emit add/sub/mul/shl/shr with nuw/nsw or exact; Offset emits inbounds gep
Not -> xor %x, -1 (or true); Neg -> sub 0, %x or fneg %x; PtrMetadata -> extracts second element llextra from Pair(ptr, meta) or const 0 for thin ptr
Const 0 for Single variant; loads tag field with !range metadata for Direct tag; compares niche value against valid range for Niche encoding and selects untagged variant or niche tag

Unsize attaches vtable GlobalAlloc::VTable or slice length to Pair; IntToInt -> trunc/zext/sext; FloatToInt -> fptosi/fptoui or saturating intrinsic; PointerExposeProvenance -> ptrtoint; PointerWithExposedProvenance -> inttoptr; Transmute -> bitcast/alloca load-store

mir_construct: Rvalue::Aggregate (Tuple, Array, Adt, Closure, Coroutine, RawPtr)
llvm_lowering: Packs all-const <=16B aggregates into a single integer store when possible; otherwise projects each field (and downcast + codegen_set_discr for enums) or builds Immediate/Pair via OperandRefBuilder

Goto merges single-predecessor block or emits br label %bb; Return loads/packs RETURN_PLACE per FnAbi::ret PassMode and emits ret; Unreachable emits unreachable (lowered to ud2/brk trap via Options.TrapUnreachable = true)
2-target switch emits icmp eq + br i1 (with !prof branch_weights when otherwise is cold); N-target switch emits switch iN %val, label %otherwise [ ... ]

mir_construct: TerminatorKind::Assert { cond, expected, msg, target, unwind }
llvm_lowering: Emits icmp + br i1 (with 2000:1 !prof branch weights favoring target) to a cold panic block calling lang item panic_const_* / panic_bounds_check / panic_misaligned_pointer_dereference with implicit caller Location

Resolves Instance (Virtual -> vtable slot GEP+load, Intrinsic -> codegen_intrinsic_call), marshals args per FnAbi PassMode (Direct/Pair/Cast/Indirect + implicit #[track_caller] Location), emits call/musttail call (or invoke when unwind action has landing pad / cleanuppad)

InlineAsm lowers to LLVM inline asm callbr/call; UnwindResume emits resume {ptr, i32} (Itanium) or cleanupret (MSVC SEH); UnwindTerminate calls core::panicking::panic_cannot_unwind (or nounwind terminate landing pad)
